The plate is a square side plate of about 20 cm, which gives the scale. The food is cooked bacon in three pieces: one long strip on the right, and two or three strips overlapping in the middle.

Cooked crispy bacon weighs roughly 8 g per slice. The right strip is about 14 cm long, so it is about 8 g. The middle cluster looks like 2 to 3 slices, so about 16 g. That makes about 24 g in total.

Crispy bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g, though the reference value given is 500, so I'll use a figure close to that.
